not_eligible_reason: these arms have no backbone at all, so they differ from a rung in more than one flag and can never enter selection.json
population: val_internal authentic vs heldout_generator generated, 19 degraded conditions, clean excluded
reading: compare against aF's own rung number. Near chance means aF's gain is complementary to the backbone; near aF means the rung is a low-level shortcut and the number is an artefact, not a finding. TPR@1%FPR is the gate because it is the selection metric; the AUC column is carried because the concern was raised in AUC terms and the two can disagree without either being wrong.
